notes.title: MECHARISE, MY NEXT GAME!
notes.notes:
It is with great pleasure that I announce here my next game:

[previewyoutube=M91OcGZtAAE;full][/previewyoutube]

Mecharise is a strategy and tower defense game that combines elements of base building, resource management, and wave-based combat against hostile aliens. Pilot a mecha as you colonize new worlds and defend your base against enemy attacks.

[b]WISHLIST NOW:[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887850/Mecharise/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887850/Mecharise/[/url]

Stay tuned, a Mecharise demo is in the works and will be released soon.
